text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"KYAAAAAAAHHH!! 
WOOOOOOOOOOOHHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"They totally surpassed everything so 
far...! 
Insane, insane, insane! They might 
actually take the crown!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Of course we will! What did ya expect? 
Romance only rains down on those who truly 
believe!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... From the very beginning, there 
was only 'conviction' within us! 
That tonight, the most brilliant light 
belongs to us!"

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"『—With that, the Pair Dance segment has 
concluded. 
Please enjoy the Free Dance Time while the 
results are being tallied.』"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"No way! How can they be so cool?! 
Kyaaa~~! That was incredible!"

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "...~~~! ...Whatever, I'm done!"

text_block_list.name: Smirking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Wait, where are you going...?! *sigh*~~"

text_block_list.name: Followers
text_block_list.text:
"What a drag... What should we do? 
Whatever, right? ...Just leave her be?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"—Good evening. Pardon the intrusion on 
your conversation. 
Are you enjoying yourselves?"

text_block_list.name: Smirking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... Journey-senpai! 
Ahaha, well... kinda, I guess...?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I see, that is wonderful to hear. 
Um... would one of you be so kind as to 
share a dance with me?"

text_block_list.name: Smirking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Huh, us? But..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The truth is, I got separated from my 
date. 
I'm terribly embarrassed to say I'm 
feeling quite out of place standing 
alone."

text_block_list.name: Smirking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I get it... Being all by yourself 
sucks, huh~. 
Well, if Senpai's asking? Not like I 
specifically wanted to dance or 
anything~."

text_block_list.name: Follower Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, she actually went... What should we 
do? 
Should we... go too? It's pretty boring... 
just standing around here..."

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—What is this... It wasn't like this last 
year at all. 
Everyone's getting all hyped up over that 
garbage... I hate this, I wanna go 
home..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"—Oh dear, how lonely. 
It seems your friends are all having quite 
a wonderful time, though."

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Wait, those guys...! Why are they 
dancing...?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"『Why』? What a curious thing to say. 
Did everyone not come here to enjoy 
dancing and chatting?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"After all, tonight is a 'joyous party.' 
I simply cannot ignore someone wearing 
such a gloomy expression."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Would you... care to dance with me as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? What are you saying... after all 
the trash I was talking...? 
There's no way I can just join in on the 
dancing now...!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My, weren't you quite good at dancing? 
I remember your unique moves from last 
year... very well indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh! I was just messing around back 
then...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What a sorrowful thing to say. 
...Even though I was genuinely moved by 
your presence.

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh...? M-Moved... by my dancing?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes... You were so dazzling that I 
couldn't even bring myself to speak to 
you. 
And yet, seeing you like this... Has 
something troubled you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fret not. I shall escort you. 
I won't let anyone say a word against you. 
...Now, take my hand—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Please, smile. 
A tearful face does not suit a "delightful 
party," after all...

And so, with the party at its peak... 
It was time to announce the Best Date...!

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
This year's Best Date is— 
Tap Dance City & Tanino Gimlet!!
(Woooooaaaaahhh!!)

Just as they promised, the two seized the 
glory. 
Amidst thunderous cheers, the Ligne Droite 
came to a close—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Guhhhhh~! We looost! 
Still... we gave it everything we had!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It was a splendid Droite. 
It seems my sister had a wonderful time as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gim-senpai looked so happy too! Her hype 
was through the roof! 
I think she was glad that I became her 
rival, heheh♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I'll surpass Gim-senpai. Not 
just at the Droite, but on the turf too! 
I know I can... do it someday! That's what 
being 'cool me' is all about, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Aaah... My flesh feels as though it could 
collapse at any moment... 
And yet, I feel as if I am ascending to 
the highest heavens. Tap... you have my 
thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Back at you! I'm completely wiped out too. 
Hehehe... Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Gimlet. 
It would've been fun if we could've 
clashed like this on the turf, too.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Even when living in the same era, fates 
do not always intertwine. 
Even so, I was certain of your strength. 
You unquestionably existed within my 
consciousness.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that's news to me. You sure know how 
to say the sweetest things. 
For a Derby Umamusume of your caliber to 
say that... Ah... I see...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Maybe we just really wanted to race each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How poetic... I rather like that truth. 
So this bond of trust was born from a 
thirst concealed deep within our 
subconscious minds, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: There you are.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kris S! How're you holding up? 
Man, I should've danced with you during 
free time too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It was a magnificent... dance. 
—A complete defeat for me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, it was razor-thin, really. 
We know all too well how strong you are. 
Right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Right! And because we both 'beat Kris S,' 
we've had this mutual respect for each 
other deep down.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Kuhahahahaha!! 
Pfft... Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, after-party time! You're coming 
too! 
Let's talk each other's ears off till 
morning!

No matter what destiny holds, the 
Umamusume push forward, believing in 
themselves. 
Whether on the turf, or on the dance 
floor...

A night of intoxication and ecstasy... 
This year's brilliantly vivid ball would 
become a legend told for generations to 
come—
